items.title: House of the Dragon — Season 3
items.note: The Targaryen civil war — the Dance of the Dragons — rages on in this Game of Thrones prequel. Season three, complete now.

items.title: Silo — Season 3
items.note: In a giant underground silo, the last of humanity lives by rigid rules no one may question — until engineer Juliette starts digging. Season three (its finale just aired), on Apple TV+.

items.title: Ted Lasso — Season 4
items.note: The relentlessly upbeat American coach returns to AFC Richmond three years on, still armed with biscuits, pep talks and big feelings. Season four brings more locker-room heart and hard-won comedy.

items.title: Reacher — Season 4
items.note: Alan Ritchson is back as Jack Reacher, the ex-army drifter who can't walk past an injustice. Season four drops him into a fresh conspiracy where his fists and his deductions do the talking.

items.title: Tires — Season 3
items.note: Shane Gillis's crude workplace comedy set in a struggling auto-repair chain, where a hapless manager and his needling cousin trade insults between customers. Season three piles on the low-stakes chaos.

items.title: Lanterns
items.note: A grounded, True-Detective-style take on DC's Green Lanterns: veteran Hal Jordan and rookie John Stewart work an earthbound murder that opens onto a much larger cosmic threat.

items.title: Dark Matter — Season 2
items.note: Based on Blake Crouch's novel, a physicist is torn from his life into a version he never chose, and has to fight back across a maze of parallel worlds. Season two widens the multiverse and the danger.

items.title: The Gentlemen
items.note: Guy Ritchie's stylish crime caper: an aristocrat inherits the family estate and discovers a sprawling cannabis empire buried beneath it. Fast-talking gangsters and double-crosses follow.

items.title: Chad Powers
items.note: Glen Powell plays a disgraced college quarterback who dons a prosthetic disguise and a fake name to sneak back onto a struggling team. A broad sports comedy; all episodes at once.

items.title: Collision
items.note: A new HBO drama; plot details are being kept under wraps ahead of release.

items.title: Neagley
items.note: A Reacher spinoff centred on Frances Neagley, his fiercely capable former colleague, running an investigation of her own. The same lean, punchy action with a sharper solo edge.

items.title: Slow Horses — Season 6
items.note: Gary Oldman's Jackson Lamb leads Slough House, MI5's dumping ground for disgraced spies who keep stumbling into cases the service would rather bury. Season six brings another darkly funny espionage tangle.

items.title: A Different World
items.note: A revival of the beloved Cosby Show spinoff set at the historically Black Hillman College, catching up with a new generation of students. Warm, funny and socially sharp.

items.title: East of Eden
items.note: A limited-series adaptation of Steinbeck's sweeping novel of family, rivalry and inheritance across generations of a California farming clan, with Florence Pugh at its centre.

items.title: War
items.note: A new HBO drama; details haven't been widely released yet.

items.title: Coven Academy
items.note: A supernatural teen drama set at a school for young witches, where secrets and dark magic simmer beneath the coursework. The full season drops at once.

items.title: The Gilded Age — Season 4
items.note: Julian Fellowes's opulent period drama pits old-money New York families against the brash new-money set in 1880s Manhattan. Season four escalates the social warfare.

items.title: Black Doves — Season 2
items.note: Keira Knightley plays a politician's wife who is secretly a spy-for-hire; when her lover is murdered, an old friend (Ben Whishaw) is sent to protect her. A slick, witty London thriller, season two.

items.title: The Rings of Power — Season 3
items.note: Amazon's Lord of the Rings prequel continues its Second Age saga of elves, dwarves and the slow rise of Sauron. Season three deepens the war for Middle-earth, weekly.

items.title: The Body
items.note: A new Netflix drama; plot details are still thin ahead of release.
A new Apple TV+ drama; specifics haven't been released yet.

items.title: The Chosen
items.note: The acclaimed, crowdfunded retelling of the life of Jesus through the eyes of those who knew him, continuing its journey through the Gospels.

items.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians — Season 3
items.note: Disney+'s adaptation of Rick Riordan's demigod adventures continues, as Percy and his friends face new mythological threats. Season three follows the next book, weekly.

items.title: Yellowjackets — Season 4
items.note: The final season of the survival thriller, cutting between a girls' soccer team stranded in the wilderness and the haunted adults they became. On Paramount+ in Canada.

items.title: Blade Runner 2099
items.note: A live-action series set fifty years after Blade Runner 2049, extending the neo-noir world of replicants and blurred humanity.

items.title: The Hunting Wives — Season 2
items.note: A soapy Texas thriller in which a newcomer is drawn into a glamorous, dangerous clique of wealthy wives — and a murder. Season two turns up the heat and the secrets.

items.title: The Witcher — Season 5
items.note: The fifth and final season of the fantasy epic, as monster-hunter Geralt, the sorceress Yennefer and the princess Ciri see their fates converge. Exact date not yet announced.

items.title: Pride and Prejudice
items.note: A new limited-series adaptation of Jane Austen's classic sparring romance between the sharp-witted Elizabeth Bennet and the proud Mr. Darcy.

items.title: The Diplomat — Season 4
items.note: Keri Russell stars as a career diplomat thrust into the high-wire role of U.S. Ambassador to the U.K. amid an international crisis — and a combustible marriage. Season four continues the fallout.

items.title: Emily in Paris — Season 6
items.note: Lily Collins's Emily juggles work, love and wardrobe across Paris (and now Rome) in the frothy fashion comedy. Season six brings more romance and croissants.

items.title: Dune: Prophecy — Season 2
items.note: A prequel set thousands of years before Dune, charting the rise of the sisterhood that becomes the Bene Gesserit. Season two continues the power games.

items.title: One Piece: Into the Grand Line — Season 2
items.note: Netflix's live-action take on the beloved manga follows Monkey D. Luffy and his pirate crew hunting the ultimate treasure. Season two sails into the Grand Line.

items.title: Lupin — Season 4
items.note: Assane Diop, inspired by gentleman-thief Arsène Lupin, pulls off elaborate heists as revenge for the wrong done to his father. Season four continues the cat-and-mouse in Paris.

items.title: The Marlow Murder Club — Season 3
items.note: In riverside Marlow, retired crossword-setter Judith and friends Suzie and Becks solve murders the police can't crack. Season three brings the amateur sleuths three fresh cases, on PBS Masterpiece.

items.title: Agatha Christie's Tommy and Tuppence
items.note: Agatha Christie's married sleuths, updated to present-day London, stumble from ordinary life into espionage and murder. A breezy whodunit on BritBox.

items.title: Marble Hall Murders
items.note: Anthony Horowitz's meta-mystery brings back editor-turned-detective Susan Ryeland (Lesley Manville), whose life keeps mirroring the crime novels she edits. On PBS Masterpiece.

items.title: Professor T — new season
items.note: Ben Miller stars as a brilliant, germophobic Cambridge criminology professor who helps police crack baffling cases while wrestling his own compulsions. On PBS Masterpiece.

items.title: Maigret
items.note: A fresh adaptation of Georges Simenon's pipe-smoking Parisian detective, who solves crimes through patience and psychology rather than action. On PBS Masterpiece.

items.title: The Gold — Season 2
items.note: Based on the real 1983 Brink's-Mat robbery, this crime drama follows the police pursuit and the underworld laundering £26 million in stolen gold. Season two, on PBS Masterpiece.

items.title: Dept. Q — Season 2
items.note: From Scott Frank, an Edinburgh-set crime drama about a prickly detective banished to a basement cold-case unit who can't stop pulling threads. Season two, on Netflix.

items.title: Showtrial — Season 2
items.note: A twisty British legal thriller that follows a high-profile case from arrest to verdict, keeping you guessing about guilt. Season two, on BritBox.

items.title: The Sommerdahl Murders — new season
items.note: Danish detective Dan Sommerdahl investigates murders in a picturesque seaside town, where work, marriage and friendship keep colliding. On BritBox.

items.title: Return to Paradise — Season 2
items.note: A spinoff of Death in Paradise: a British detective decamps to sunny coastal Australia and reluctantly solves local murders. Season two, on BritBox.

items.title: The Good Ship Murder — Season 3
items.note: A cruise-ship entertainer with a knack for detection keeps stumbling onto murders at sea. Season three sets sail, on BritBox.

items.title: Inspector Ellis — Season 2
items.note: Sharon D. Clarke stars as DCI Ellis, a no-nonsense detective parachuted into troubled cases and hostile stations to get results. Season two, on Acorn TV.

items.title: Harry Wild — Season 5
items.note: Jane Seymour plays a retired literature professor who muscles into her detective son's cases and turns out to be a natural sleuth. Season five, set in Dublin, on Acorn TV.

items.title: A Woman of Substance
items.note: A period rags-to-riches saga following a servant girl's rise to build a retail empire, with Brenda Blethyn. On BritBox.

items.title: Trigger Point — Season 3
items.note: Vicky McClure stars as a frontline bomb-disposal officer under relentless pressure as a bombing campaign grips London. Season three, on BritBox.

items.title: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
items.note: The fourth chapter of Ryan Murphy's true-crime anthology dramatizes Lizzie Borden and the infamous 1892 Fall River axe murders. All at once, on Netflix.

items.title: Outlander: Blood of My Blood — Season 2
items.note: A prequel to Outlander tracing the love stories of Jamie's and Claire's parents across two eras of Scottish and English history. A Starz original that streams on Disney+ in Canada; premiere date still tentative.

items.title: The Bear — Season 5
items.note: The final season of the kitchen drama following chef Carmy and his crew as they chase greatness while wrestling grief and ambition. All episodes at once.

items.title: The Shards
items.note: Ryan Murphy adapts Bret Easton Ellis's autofiction: in 1980s L.A., a teenage 'Bret' becomes convinced a new classmate is tied to a serial killer stalking the city. Dread-soaked and complete now.

items.title: Bad Monkey — Season 2
items.note: Vince Vaughn plays a suspended Florida detective demoted to restaurant inspector who tugs on a case involving a severed arm and a lot of local corruption. A sun-baked mystery-comedy from Bill Lawrence; season two.

items.title: Only Murders in the Building — Season 6
items.note: Steve Martin, Martin Short and Selena Gomez return as the true-crime-podcasting trio, this time chasing a case that takes them to London. A witty murder mystery.

items.title: Death in Paradise — Series 16
items.note: Sun, sand and impossible murders: a British detective solves locked-room cases on the fictional Caribbean island of Saint Marie. Series sixteen, on BritBox.

items.title: The Pitt — Season 3
items.note: A medical drama that unfolds in real time across a single punishing ER shift, led by Noah Wyle. Season three.

items.title: The Night Manager — Season 3
items.note: Tom Hiddleston returns as Jonathan Pine, the hotel night manager turned spy, in a new le Carré-inspired chapter of international intrigue. On Prime Video.

items.title: Star Trek: Starfleet Academy — Season 2
items.note: A new generation of cadets trains for Starfleet under looming threats. Season two, on Paramount+.

items.title: The Last of Us — Season 3
items.note: The acclaimed game adaptation continues its brutal, tender journey through a fungus-ravaged America. Season three arrives in 2027.

items.title: The White Lotus — Season 4
items.note: Mike White's Emmy-winning anthology checks a new set of wealthy, dysfunctional guests into a luxury resort — where a death is never far off. A fresh cast and locale.

items.title: Severance — Season 3

items.title: Euphoria — Season 3
items.note: The raw, stylized drama about teens navigating addiction, love and identity returns after a long wait. Season three, led by Zendaya.

items.title: Wednesday — Season 3

items.title: Bridgerton — Season 5

items.title: Beyond Paradise — Series 5

items.note: Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show reboots with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.

items.title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball

items.note: While haunted by memories of a failed arrest that allowed the Ripton Stalker to remain free, retired detective Inspector Huw Miller becomes suspicious of his enigmatic new neighbour Patrick Harbottle.

items.title: Ricky Gervais Alley Cats
items.note: Outrageous misadventures run wild as feral cats cause chaos on the streets in this no-holds-barred animated comedy from Ricky Gervais.

items.title: Unchosen
items.note: When a young mother from a sheltered cult crosses paths with a mysterious stranger, she embarks on a risky affair that awakens desires and dark secrets.

items.title: The Girlfriend

items.note: What if we could see the universe from a different perspective? If we were not constrained to Earth's gravity, and we could fly across space and see the planets from up-close? Well, we'd probably freak out after we notice they have a face.

items.title: Gone
items.note: When a headmaster's wife goes missing, suspicion falls on him. Is he hiding something, or is there more to this case than meets the eye?

items.title: The Ridge

items.title: Man vs Baby

items.title: Hostage

items.title: How to Get to Heaven from Belfast

items.title: The Witness

items.title: Million Dollar Secret

items.title: The Woman in the Yard

items.title: Fear Street: Prom Queen

items.title: Southern Scares

items.title: The Dogs

items.title: Honey Don't!

items.title: Oscar Shaw

items.title: One Mile: Chapter One

items.title: The Alto Knights
